title: An error analysis of discrete Kirchhoff elements
summary: The Discrete Kirchhoff Triangle (DKT) method for the biharmonic equation is analyzed in the discrete energy norm. The error is bounded by the best approximation of the Hessian by piecewise constants and the oscillation of the right-hand side, without additional regularity assumptions on the exact solution. This result implies first-order convergence of the classical DKT element and the analysis yields a canonical extension to three space dimensions with the same approximation properties.
